import hashlib,json,re,urllib.request
url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jellyfin/jellyfin-android/v2.7.3/app/src/main/java/org/jellyfin/mobile/player/queue/QueueManager.kt"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=15) as response:
 data=response.read(400000);status=response.status
source=data.decode()
http=re.search(r'MediaProtocol\.HTTP\s*->\s*\{([^}]+)\}',source,re.S)
file=re.search(r'MediaProtocol\.FILE\s*->\s*\{([^}]+)\}',source,re.S)
result={"scope":"public upstream source only","http_status":status,"git_blob_sha1":hashlib.sha1(("blob "+str(len(data))+"\0").encode()+data).hexdigest(),"http_direct_uses_source_path":bool(http and "sourceInfo.path" in http.group(1)),"http_direct_forces_hls":bool(http and "MimeTypes.APPLICATION_M3U8" in http.group(1)),"file_direct_uses_jellyfin_stream_api":bool(file and "videosApi.getVideoStreamUrl" in file.group(1)),"forced_mime_applied":".setMimeType(forcedMimeType)" in source,"physical_playback_test":False}
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if all(result[k] for k in ("http_direct_uses_source_path","http_direct_forces_hls","file_direct_uses_jellyfin_stream_api","forced_mime_applied")) else 1)
